session.idle.command: echo "$(opencode session list | grep "{session_id}" | awk -F'  +' '{print $2}')\nStatus:  Agent finished\nURL: https://opencode.whammou.dedyn.io/$(echo -n "$PWD" | base64 -w0)/session/{session_id}"

session.error.command: echo "$(opencode session list | grep "{session_id}" | awk -F'  +' '{print $2}')\nStatus:  Agent error — {error}\nURL: https://opencode.whammou.dedyn.io/$(echo -n "$PWD" | base64 -w0)/session/{session_id}"

permission.asked.command: echo "$(opencode session list | grep "{session_id}" | awk -F'  +' '{print $2}')\nStatus:  Permission {permission_type} for {permission_patterns}\nURL: https://opencode.whammou.dedyn.io/$(echo -n "$PWD" | base64 -w0)/session/{session_id}"
